routes.title: Ocean Conservation NGO in Ghana | Ocean Tribe Foundation
routes.description: Ocean Tribe Foundation is a Ghanaian NGO fighting plastic pollution through beach cleanups in Accra, plastic recovery, school education and coastal restoration.
routes.h1: Restoring the Ocean, Rebuilding the Future
routes.summary: Ocean Tribe Foundation is a Ghana-based ocean conservation NGO running beach cleanups at Teshie, Nungua and Laboma, plastic recovery projects, and plastic waste education in schools across Greater Accra.
routes.label: Home

routes.title: About Us | Ghana Ocean Conservation NGO | Ocean Tribe
routes.description: Meet Ocean Tribe Foundation, a Ghanaian non-profit protecting Greater Accra's coastline through community-led beach cleanups, plastic recovery and education.
routes.summary: Our vision is to restore and protect Ghana's coastlines through community-driven conservation, circular economy initiatives and sustainable livelihoods.
routes.label: About

routes.title: Our Programs: Beach Cleanups & Plastic Recovery in Ghana
routes.description: Beach cleanups in Accra, school plastic recovery bins, teacher training, plastic buy-back centres, trash booms and mangrove restoration along Ghana's coast.
routes.summary: Six connected programs tackle plastic pollution in Ghana: beach cleanups and waste data, school plastic education, plastic buy-back centres, trash booms at drainage points, sustainable fishing and mangrove restoration.
routes.label: Programs

routes.title: Our Impact & 2025–2030 Strategic Plan | Ocean Tribe
routes.description: See what Ocean Tribe Foundation has delivered on Ghana's coast so far and our 2025–2030 plan to cut ocean plastic, create green jobs and restore mangroves.
routes.summary: From the first Laboma beach cleanup in 2025 to school plastic recovery programs in 2026, and a 2025–2030 roadmap for buy-back centres, biodiversity monitoring and mangrove restoration.
